architecture.title: Evidence checklist — the model finds evidence, people decide
architecture.caption: Only lawfully obtained, minimised professional text reaches Jev. Code splits it into numbered sentences; Jev selects the evidence id or not_stated per criterion; code quotes the sentence verbatim. Every record goes to a recruiter — no score, no rank, no rejection.

nodes.label: Minimise
nodes.sub: no name, photo, age, gender, nationality

sequence.title: Lab 06-2 — select, don't generate
sequence.caption: Jev only ever returns a sentence id. The quotation the recruiter sees is copied from the original text by code, so it cannot be fabricated.

steps.label: split candidate-004 into s1 · s2 · s3
which sentence evidences integration / building / python?
integration s1 (0.99) · building s1 (1.00) · python not_stated (0.64)
“Led a team that wrote BACnet drivers in C++.” + ask about Python
low confidence on 'reviewed Python PRs' = a judgment call for a person
